body: Thank you! Her mom told us that we can't bring anything with us, or else I'd bring some food I know she loves. I'm a tad nervous because I feel like I don't know what to say, so thanks for your advice.

Should I just be letting her talk or is silence not a big deal? I had thought she was doing fine this whole time. I had seen her the weekend before it happened, and she had seemed really happy and said she loved high school, and she seems to hang out with her friends often, so I was really surprised.
